description: FFXIV 1.23b opcode catalog joined with pcap observations and retail-client analysis. WorldMapBackend holds world<->map backbone packets; both backend directions share opcode integers. WorldMapBackend entries are server-to-server and never cross the client TCP socket, so client-capture pcap evidence is structurally impossible for those wire values. A catalog extension added 4 client-side receiver opcodes (0x018E SetRetainerStar, 0x01A2 JobQuestCompleteTriple, 0x01A6 HamletSupplyRanking, 0x01A8 HamletDefenseScore); evidence is xivl-client-structs client receiver decomp.

corpus_evidence_files.description: Four corpus-mining outputs from the cross-reference extractors. Each surfaces a different angle on the existing pcap corpus without requiring new captures. Per-opcode notes reference these files; this index documents the files at the catalog root.

files.scope: 5 zone-transition pcaps; 55 cross-capture rare s2c opcodes
files.key_finding: No opcode matches the '1-2 fires per capture spread non-periodically' signature of a true trigger-box. Inventory snapshot opcodes (0x016D/0x016E) and GroupMembersX08 (0x017F) hit all 5 captures but as zone-load bundle members, not trigger-box markers. Live capture remains the only path for resolving trigger-box slots 19-22 (now reclassified client_internal via the vftable-write immediate scan, so this finding is closure rather than blocker).

339 distinct (target, id) pairs across 15 targets. 263 distinct property IDs, 100% already resolved via gam_hash_names.json. Top targets: charaWork/potencial (50 records, 8 ids), charaWork/battleParameter (36/14), charaWork/battleStateForSelf (35/17). Structural enrichment for understanding what SyncMemory carries; future captures with unresolved hashes can use target prefix narrowing.

files.scope: 53 captures; 11 c2s opcodes with s2c responses within 200ms
files.key_finding: Top reliable bindings: c2s 0x0133 -> s2c 0x0137 (180 pairs, 67% c2sShare = action command triggers SyncMemory property update); c2s 0x0001 -> s2c 0x0190 (38% heartbeat -> echo); c2s 0x00CC LockTarget -> 0x0190 + 0x00D3 + 0x0001 (composite response). Useful for narrowing receiver candidates when c2s submission context is known.

All four Text Sheet Message family opcodes (0x0166-0x0169) are zero-baseline NPC-only with high enrichment; 0x0167 has 63 fires in 4/10 NPC captures (enrichment 0.998). Used to confirm SendLogReceiver (slot 63) opcode binding for the 0x0157-0x016A range. This file is the only one of the four extractor outputs integrated into the catalog; the 20 SendLog opcode entries in MapClientbound already reference it.

pcap_c2s_evidence_note: Added pcap-grounded observedIn / payloadLengths to c2s entries (xivl-client-structs BCS-Y series). Source: 54 pcapng scenarios in xivl-captures/captures, parsed via 1.x BasePacket / SubPacket / GameMessage framing (unencrypted in this corpus, zlib decompression for s2c-side). Also refined the 0x01C3..0x01DF + 0x00CA generic placeholder likely_role labels on decomp_opcodes.json entries from pcap correlation - the cluster was a static-scan grouping, not a runtime grouping (combat c2s is 0x012D, not the cluster).
pcap_s2c_evidence_note: Mirrored the earlier c2s pcap-evidence merge on clientbound entries (xivl-client-structs BCS-Y): 48 unique s2c opcodes in the corpus get observedIn / payloadLengths from pcap_opcode_evidence.json. Heavy s2c traffic concentrated in party_battle_leve (45 unique), moving_around_gridania (22), gridania_to_coerthas (18).
